chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from Ali ibn Hassan; and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah ibn A'yan, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Everyone who exceeds the sunnah (prophetic tradition) is to be returned to the sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.السُّنَّةَ: the normative prophetic tradition and prescribed way
key_terms.تَعَدَّى: went beyond, exceeded the proper limit

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by returning one who exceeds the sunnah back to the sunnah?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the sunnah (prophetic tradition) as the standard by which excess and deviation are corrected. It emphasizes that when a person goes beyond the proper bounds, the criterion for return and rectification is the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
